checkpoints.title: Dinner at Kantýna

Groceries

checkpoints.title: Baba - Sarka Loop
checkpoints.description: The route starts at the parking lot at the Divoká Šárka swimming pool and heads to Prague Nebušice. The trail then runs along the Sanatorium and along Dolní Šárka. At the Vltava, the route turns back through the forest of Zlatnice, Jenerálk and Divoká Šárka. The road also passes the Džbán Valley Reservoir. In certain parts, this route can be a bit more demanding, but the navigation very straightforward.
